item.title: RIG Riot
item.description:
Title: RIG Riot
Genre: Action
Developer: Sage Boatman
Publisher: Sage Boatman
Release Date: Sep 14, 2026




About This Game

RIG Riot is a roguelike third-person mech-action shooter. Fight increasingly difficult enemies while completing objectives, level up, and choose the Weapons and Volatile Mods that will let you return from your raids victorious. Discover thousands of permanent parts, and build a RIG unlike any other.

Exciting Combat

Combat can feel quite different depending on the style of RIG you build. Do you prefer a light and mobile mech that bombards their foes from range with a trusty sniper? How about a well-rounded powerhouse who focuses on bringing the pain with missile bombardments and automatic rifles? Or maybe you prefer a tanky build that barrels through all opposition with laser blades and shotguns? Put together your build and then prepare for fast-paced combat against a wide array of enemies.

Deep Customization

In RIG Riot, every loss is an opportunity. Dive into the garage and check out the exciting new parts you've earned. Every part in RIG Riot is made out of a combination of components from the various full sets available in the game. There are an incredible amount of parts to find- which will you use?


Powerful Synergies

Finds the best ways to make your unique RIG shine as you travel through increasingly difficult stages. Search for rare weapons and mods with effects that compliment your build to see just how far you can go.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

* Combat between non-human entities, primarily inorganic mechanical vehicles, that are implied to contain human pilots
* Textual descriptions of fantasy drug use



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4790K CPU @ 4.00 GHz
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce GTX960
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 10 GB available space

item.title: TCG Card Shop Simulator
item.description:
Title: TCG Card Shop Simulator
Genre: Simulation
Developer: OPNeon Games
Publisher: OPNeon Games
Release Date: Sep 14, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 15, 2024




About This Game

TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

Manage Your Shop:

Design your own TCG shop. Organize shelves and card packs to make the customer shopping experience smooth and easy.

Card Collection:

Open the booster packs yourself and collect the cards. Find rare cards and sell them to make a fortune, or keep them to complete your card collection.

Host Game:

Set your card game format and fee, invite players to play card games in your shop. Be sure to keep your store clean and hygienic for the players or they might leave!

Order Products:

Stock up on different booster card packs and card game products. Keep track of popular trends and adjust your inventory to cater to the ever-changing demands of your customers.

Expand Your Business:

Earn profits to reinvest in your shop. Expand your space, unlock new card sets, and upgrade your facilities to attract even more customers and increase revenue.

item.title: Fish Lab
item.description:
Title: Fish Lab
Genre: Action , Casual , Indie
Developer: stonecodes
Publisher: stonecodes
Release Date: Sep 14, 2026




About This Game

A short incremental game where you collect fish for your lab. Synced to music.

100,000 fish on screen

Hover your cursor over fish to collect on the beat. Use a variety of tools to collect as many fish as you can.

The lab gets huge

Every fish you collect earns you money. As you play the lab automatically grows.

Choose how to power your tools

Decide which tools get extra power.

Upgrade your lab and equipment

Write grants to unlock big equipment upgrades on top of the 200+ upgrades in the tech tree.

Extra Game Modes

  • Sandbox

  • Endless

  • Zen - installable as a real Windows screensaver

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

No AI-generated images and I made all the music by hand. Some text may be translated with AI.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: 2.5 GHz dual-core
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Radeon RX Vega 11 / Intel Iris Xe / GTX 1050 2GB
    • Storage: 700 MB available space

MacOS

    Minimum:
    • Requires an Apple processor
    • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur
    • Processor: Apple Silicon only
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated GPU (Metal)
    • Storage: 700 MB available space

Linux

    Minimum:
    • OS: SteamOS 3 / linux
    • Processor: 2.5 GHz x86-64 dual-core
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Radeon RX Vega 11 / Intel Iris Xe / GTX 1050 2GB
    • Storage: 700 MB available space

item.title: Tenebris: Terra Incognita
item.description:
Title: Tenebris: Terra Incognita
Genre: Adventure , Indie , RPG , Strategy
Developer: Phantasmica Studios
Publisher: Phantasmica Studios
Release Date: Sep 14, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 30, 2024




About This Game

Tenebris: Terra Incognita is a challenging turn-based RPG set in a gloomy science fiction setting. Take command of the best fighters of humanity and save the expedition of the Solaris starship, which crashed on an uncharted planet infested with terrible monsters!

CHARACTERS

We are big fans of series like Darkest Dungeon, X-COM and Disciples, and we want to give players a similar experience through deep hero customization and career progression. Having 5 basic classes with easily recognizable roles at the beginning of the playthrough, the player will be able to choose character development branches from 17 advanced classes as they gain experience. Each specialization has separate talent trees, allowing the player to create unique characters within the same class.

The game has a full inventory system. Found or purchased items - weapons, armor, special equipment - can not only improve the basic characteristics of the characters, but also influence their talents or give new abilities.

  • Experiment with the talent branches of the characters.

  • Combine your abilities with equipment items.

  • Create your own unique build, and conquer the world of Tenebris!

MONSTERS

The damaged hull of the ship turned out to be the least of the expedition's problems: the people, not having time to recover from the heavy landing, were immediately attacked by huge bugs. The size, speed and aggressiveness of the enemy would not be such a problem if not for the amazing organization of the swarm. These bugs, through chemical signals, are able not only to coordinate, but also to strengthen and accelerate each other. The more there are, the more dangerous each individual enemy is.

If you manage to defend the starship and gain a foothold in the insect-infested Misty Wasteland, your troops will be able to open other areas where the bug scouts do not dare to go. And if you learn from the swarm, you will understand: there, beyond the borders of the wasteland, you will need new abilities, different combat tactics and, most likely - bigger guns.

STARSHIP "SOLARIS"

The Solaris starship is your base and the only relatively safe place on the planet. Here you can purchase weapons and armor, awaken new recruits from cryo-sleep and send wounded heroes for treatment. The resources found in missions will allow you to improve the ship's bays and expand the capabilities of your squad.

In addition to the expedition commander and the head of the security service, together with whom you will solve the main task of escaping the planet, you will be assisted by the chief doctor, leading engineer and warehouse manager. Each crew member will have unique tasks for you, and solving them will allow you to obtain additional resources and technologies that can increase the chances of survival of the expedition.

Be careful - the ship's supplies are scarce, and you will have to fight for the planet's resources. You have to carefully choose what to spend the little you can get in battles.

Will you be able to conquer the dark planet and save the expedition?

The crew has left all the decisions to you - proceed at your own risk!

item.title: The Headlands
item.description:
Title: The Headlands
Genre: Strategy , Early Access
Developer: TessaraOxygen
Publisher: TessaraOxygen
Release Date: Sep 14, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 14, 2026




About This Game

The Headlands is a cozy farming strategy about a small Ukrainian village caught between two eras: Soviet machinery and an independent countryside on the verge of the 2000s. Ahead of you lies a run-down farm waiting for a new beginning.

Start small: an old tractor, a neglected field and limited resources. Step by step, work the land, sow the grain, bring in the harvest and gradually build a farm that runs on your decisions.

At the heart of the game are your own pace and balance. You decide which fields to work first, when to invest in new machinery and how to make the most of your time, fuel and grain. Market prices live a life of their own — and sometimes the price of grain shifts exactly when it is already in the truck bed. There are no timers pushing you and no sudden punishments — only thoughtful planning and steady, tangible progress.

Every tractor here is the one you saw in the fields as a child: the same engine, the same rattle, the same peeling paint. Maybe you even remember the moustachioed neighbour who once let you climb into the cab while he checked something under the hood — and you sat there alone like a cosmonaut in a spacecraft, studying every lever and every button.

Every machine in the game has its own character and story. And you won't be left alone with them: there is always a mechanic and mentor nearby who will advise you, and in his spare time will put together a machine that has no name in any catalogue.

Help your neighbours through contracts, unlock new opportunities and turn a small holding into a living, well-run farm.

Start small. Give the land time. And you'll see everything begin to grow.

🌾 Meditative strategy gameplay. Planning without rush and the freedom to choose your own pace.

🚜 Gradual farm growth. From a single tractor to a full holding with a large fleet and expanded buildings.

📦 A living market and resource balance. Time, fuel and harvest are all connected, and prices won't wait until you are ready.

🔧 Machines with character. Dozens of vehicles with a history — from the mechanic's homemade "masterpieces" to heavy combines.

🏭 Your own production — set up supply chains and sell finished goods for more than raw materials.

🤝 Contracts and village life. Help your neighbours and develop the region together.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

This game contains limited AI-assisted content in the form of contract illustrations. These images are used for illustrative purposes only and have no impact on gameplay. They will be replaced with hand-drawn artwork in a future update. No AI is used to generate content during gameplay.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 / AMD FX-6300 or better
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 730 / AMD Radeon R7 240 or better (2015 and newer)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 1 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Any

MacOS

    Minimum:
    • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or newer
    • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel 64-bit
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
    • Storage: 1 GB available space
